mapper.sql: id, quotation_code, customer_id, salesman_id, procurement_cost, procurement_cost_state, logistics_cost, logistics_cost_state, total_cost, total_cost_state, order_amount, logistics_remark, discount_amount, receive_address_id, receive_address, special_requirements, status, reject_reason, shift_status, currency, tax, fob, exw, exchange_rate, create_user, create_time, update_user, update_time, tenant_id, is_deleted
mapper.update: UPDATE sal_sed_quotation SET procurement_cost=#{procurementCost}, procurement_cost_state='1' WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select:
select a.id as quotationId, a.quotation_code as quotationCode, b.name as customerName, a.create_time as createTime FROM sal_sed_quotation a left join sal_yt_customer b on a.customer_id=b.id WHERE a.is_deleted = 0
AND a.quotation_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{quotationCode}, '%')
AND b.`name` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{customerName}, '%')
AND a.create_time >= #{createTime} AND a.create_time < DATE_ADD(#{createTime}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
ORDER BY a.create_time DESC

select a.id as id, a.customer_id as customerId, b.`name` as customerName, a.receive_address_id receiveAddressId, a.receive_address as receiveAddress, a.special_requirements as specialRequirements, c.user_id as salesmanId, c.nick_name as salesmanName, a.procurement_cost as procurementCost, a.procurement_cost_state as procurementCostState, a.logistics_cost as logisticsCost, a.logistics_cost_state as logisticsCostState, a.logistics_remark as logisticsRemark, a.discount_amount as discountAmount, a.order_amount as orderAmount, a.status, a.reject_reason as rejectReason, a.currency as currency, a.tax as tax, a.fob as fob, a.exw as exw, a.exchange_rate as exchangeRate, a.shift_status as shiftStatus from sal_sed_quotation a left join sal_yt_customer b on a.customer_id=b.id left join sys_user c on b.belong_employee_id=c.user_id where a.id=#{id}

select a.id as id, a.quotation_code as quotationCode, b.`name` as customerName, c.nick_name as salesmanName, a.create_time as createTime from sal_sed_quotation a left join sal_yt_customer b on a.customer_id = b.id left join sys_user c on b.belong_employee_id = c.user_id where a.is_deleted = 0 and a.status = '4'
and a.quotation_code like concat('%', #{quotationCode}, '%')
and exists ( select 1 from sal_sed_quotation_sku sku left join pro_sed_product_match_sku pms on sku.sku_id = pms.id left join pro_sed_product_match pmt on pms.match_id = pmt.id where sku.quotation_id = a.id and sku.is_deleted = 0
and pms.name like concat('%', #{skuName}, '%')
and pmt.name like concat('%', #{matchName}, '%')
)
order by a.create_time desc

select b.`name` as item, a.quantity as moq, b.weight as weightPerUnit, a.quotation_price as fobNingboPrice, a.remark as remarks, a.sku_id as skuId, a.product_id as productId, a.id as quotationSkuId, a.match_id as matchId, a.volume as volume, c.packing_size as packingSize, c.cost as packingCost from sal_sed_quotation_sku a left join pro_sed_product b on a.product_id=b.id left join sal_sed_quotation_sku_packing c on a.id = c.quotation_sku_id where a.quotation_id=#{quotationId}
